onPlay.name: onPlay
onPlay.when: playCard(): after cost paid and card moved to its pile
onPlay.order: Runs the card effect. Keep: cost → move pile → onBeforeCardPlay → effect → onCardPlayed.

onCombatStart.name: onCombatStart
onCombatStart.when: startCombat(): after enemies spawn and the Cartographer starting Waypoint, before Opening cards are placed and before the first startTurn()
onCombatStart.order: Relics in pickup order, then potions-with-passives. Choices (Moon Shell tide pick, Sextant pick) need a mode that blocks the first draw.

onCombatEnd.name: onCombatEnd
onCombatEnd.when: win() before W.cb is cleared and rewards are built (also escape via Mist Bomb with won:false? — no rewards)
onCombatEnd.order: Heals/gold before reward screen; combat-scoped listeners are dropped after.

onTurnStart.name: onTurnStart
onTurnStart.when: startTurn(): after Guard reset + energy reset, BEFORE Waypoint triggers and the draw
onTurnStart.order: Delayed "next turn" effects → relics → powers → Waypoints → draw (base + bonuses) → onAfterDraw. Hard-coded today: engarde, perfNext, wpDraw.

onAfterDraw.name: onAfterDraw
onAfterDraw.when: startTurn(): after the opening draw of each turn (and after Chart-before-draw)
onAfterDraw.order: For effects that add/return cards or ask a choice the player should see their hand for (Tide Table, Eternal Refrain, Choir).

onTurnEnd.name: onTurnEnd
onTurnEnd.order: onTurnEnd → Echo (modifyEchoPlan/onEcho) → onTurnEndInHand per hand card → Fleeting sink / Moor keep / discard rest → momentum reset → enemy phase.

onTurnEndInHand.name: onTurnEndInHand
onTurnEndInHand.when: endTurn(): for each card still in hand, after Echo, before discard
onTurnEndInHand.order: Curses/statuses (Scald, Brine Rot, Dread, Leaky Hull). Fleeting cards still fire this before they Sink.

onRoundEnd.name: onRoundEnd
onRoundEnd.when: after the enemy phase, before the next startTurn()
onRoundEnd.order: Expire "this turn" debuffs that must survive the enemy attack (Kraken's Grasp, Prise de Fer), clear Retort window. tick() exists but only for weak/vuln.

canPlay.name: canPlay
canPlay.order: Energy check, Unplayable flag, card.req(f) (Coda, En Passant), then global limits (Siren's Whisper, Solo).
canPlay.engine: combat.js canPlay() has energy + d.unplay only

modifyCost.name: modifyCost
modifyCost.when: cost(ci) every time it is read (render + play)
modifyCost.order: base/upgraded → X → set-to-0 effects (tmp0, Rubato, Flags, Blade Waltz, Orders) → −n discounts (Low Note) → +n taxes (Barnacled, Satchel; min 1 for Satchel) → clamp ≥0. "Next card" effects are consumed in onCardPlayed, not when read.

xCost.name: xCost
xCost.when: playCard(): spend all energy, expose X to the effect
xCost.order: Echo of an X card should reuse the X it was played with (store on f/ci).

onBeforeCardPlay.name: onBeforeCardPlay
onBeforeCardPlay.when: playCard(): after cost/pile move, before the effect runs
onBeforeCardPlay.order: Flourish flag is decided here (exists inline); Mimic Ink sets a replay; Bleeding Edge arms its rider.

onCardPlayed.name: onCardPlayed
onCardPlayed.when: playCard(): after the effect and the Momentum update
onCardPlayed.order: Counters (cb.playedTurn, cb.playedCombat, cb.attacksTurn, cb.attacksCombat) are incremented BEFORE listeners fire so "4th card" checks see 4.

onDraw.name: onDraw
onDraw.when: drawCards(): per card as it enters the hand
onDraw.order: Card self-trigger first (Static, Wreck Ghost, Seasick), then listeners (Planned Route). Must not recurse infinitely (Gambit draws until Attack).

onShuffle.name: onShuffle
onShuffle.when: refill(): when discard is shuffled into draw
onShuffle.order: After the new draw pile is built (Inkwell inserts Murk into it).

onSink.name: onSink
onSink.when: any card moved to cb.exh (played Sink, Fleeting, Bilge Pump, Powers?)
onSink.order: Powers moving to exh should NOT count as Sink (design: Powers are "played", not sunk) — decide and document.

kwOpening.name: kwOpening
kwOpening.sig: open flag (deck card instance or def)
kwOpening.when: startCombat(): move to top of draw before the first draw
kwOpening.order: Ship's Rutter sets it on a deck instance (ci.open).

kwFaint.name: kwFaint
kwFaint.order: v2: if the last card is Faint, Echo the most recent NON-Faint card played this turn (v1 just skips).

dmgApi.name: dmgApi
dmgApi.order: Must route every hit through the modifyDamage / onAttackHit pipeline once those exist.

guardApi.name: guardApi
guardApi.order: Must route card Guard through modifyGuard (Poise/Brittle) once it exists; flag non-card Guard (relics, Undertow) so Poise/Brittle skip it.

drawApi.name: drawApi
drawApi.order: Hand limit 10 (→ handLimit modifier). Each drawn card fires onDraw.

createCard.name: createCard
createCard.order: Respect hand limit 10 (overflow → discard). Tokens (Note, Flotsam…) and statuses use it; enemy status intents too.

selectCards.name: selectCards
selectCards.order: choose()/pickSlot()/chart() modes exist; need hand/pile pickers.

choose.name: choose
choose.order: Echoed cards must auto-pick (random or best) since Echo has no player choice.

upgradeForCombat.name: upgradeForCombat
upgradeForCombat.order: cards.js cost()/desc() read ci.up; need ci.up||ci.tmpUp.

moveCard.name: moveCard
moveCard.order: Return from discard, put on top of draw, draw specific position, play from top of draw (Far Sight).

delayed.name: delayed
delayed.order: Generic version of perfNext / wpDraw. Turn-scoped listeners auto-expire in endTurn; next-turn ones fire in onTurnStart.

counters.name: counters
counters.sig: cb.stat.{playedTurn, playedCombat, attacksTurn, attacksCombat, tideturnsTurn, tideturnsCombat, crests, undertows, echoesTurn, echoesCombat, wpDestroyed, lastTideDir, lastEchoed}
counters.order: played / atkCount exist; the rest are missing.

modifyDamage.name: modifyDamage
modifyDamage.sig: modifyDamage(src, ctx{source, card, target, base, isAttack, hitIndex, bonus, mult, ignoreGuard})
modifyDamage.order: base(+Sustain) → +flat (Might, Duel Focus/Oath, Trench Dweller, Salted Blade, Cavity, Infinite Hum/Echo Chamber, Whale Tooth) → ×Flourish (×2, Grip Tape ×3) → ×Echo mult (Amplify/Tuning Fork) → Soaked ×0.75 → Exposed ×1.5 → floor. Design §2.1: Flourish doubles after Might.
modifyDamage.engine: combat.js hit(): pstr, duel focus, flourish, weak, vuln hard-coded

onAttackHit.name: onAttackHit
onAttackHit.when: hit(): per Attack (once for "one Attack" multi-hits)
onAttackHit.order: before: Bleed HP loss (ignores Guard, then −1 unless Hemorrhage). after: Barbs, Oath bleed, Death by Inches.

onDamageDealt.name: onDamageDealt
onDamageDealt.order: Crimson Flourish uses final damage dealt; f.lastDealt for effects.

onEnemyKilled.name: onEnemyKilled
onEnemyKilled.order: Fire after hp set to 0; card-level "if this kills" reads f.killed.

onPlayerAttacked.name: onPlayerAttacked
onPlayerAttacked.order: Parry resolves first (reduce + reflect), then Guard, then HP. Retort flag set here.

onPlayerDeath.name: onPlayerDeath
onPlayerDeath.order: Relics (Siren Scale) before potions (Second Tide)?? — design does not say; propose relic first.

loseHp.name: loseHp
loseHp.order: Unblockable self damage (Reckless Flourish, Brine Rot). Scald says "take 2 damage" — Guard applies? (data issue).

modifyGuard.name: modifyGuard
modifyGuard.order: base(+Sustain) → +Poise → ×0.75 Brittle → floor. Relic/Waypoint Guard: does Poise apply? (design says "from cards").

onApplyStatus.name: onApplyStatus
onApplyStatus.order: Ward negates first (consumes 1 per debuff application), then Open Veins (+1 Bleed).

statusSet.name: statusSet
statusSet.order: weak/vuln/str exist; others missing. Player Might is cb.pstr (unify with st.str?).

onTideChange.name: onTideChange
onTideChange.order: Clamp → fire onSurge/onRecede → detect Tideturn → Crest/Undertow check. Slack Water suppresses card-caused shifts.

onSurge.name: onSurge
onSurge.order: High Water Mark checks High Tide BEFORE the move ("while at High Tide").

onTideTurn.name: onTideTurn
onTideTurn.when: tideShift() when sign(delta) ≠ cb.tideDir (Crest/Undertow reset is not a move; Set-the-Tide counts by direction)
onTideTurn.order: Update counters → fire. King Tide combo: a forced Crest then Undertow must count.

onCrest.name: onCrest
onCrest.order: modifyCrest (Spring ×2→16, Moonstone +4, Perigee resetTo 7) → deal → onCrest listeners (Moon Shell energy, Anklet Exposed, counters) → reset. f.causedCrest for "if this causes a Crest".

onUndertow.name: onUndertow
onUndertow.sig: onUndertow(src, {guard, draw, cause}) + modifyUndertow(ctx{guard, draw, resetTo})
onUndertow.order: Mirror of onCrest (Neap 16/2, Moonstone +4, Abyssal Stillness resetTo 3).

tideQuery.name: tideQuery
tideQuery.order: f.low/high computed at play time exist; "if now at Low Tide" needs a live getter.

modifyEchoPlan.name: modifyEchoPlan
modifyEchoPlan.order: Build plan (last non-Faint card; Fermata adds previous) → Overtone/Standing/Solo/Resonance Vial add repeats → Amplify/Solo/Tuning Fork set mult → CAP total repeats at 4 per turn (log "capped").

onEcho.name: onEcho
onEcho.order: Card self (Sustain growth ci.sus += X(+Sostenuto), Ostinato, Living Song) → relics (Tuning Peg, Organ Pipe via plan) → powers (Cavity). cb.echoesTurn/Combat++.

sustain.name: sustain
sustain.sig: sus:n on def, ci.sus per combat
sustain.order: Replaces v1 ci.cres. Per-hit for Tremolo.

onWaypointTrigger.name: onWaypointTrigger
onWaypointTrigger.when: trigWp(): start of turn + manual triggers (Signal Mirror, Triangulate)
onWaypointTrigger.order: Atlas = trigger each slot twice; Ley Lines fires per trigger.

onDecamp.name: onDecamp
onDecamp.order: Card Decamp effect → listeners (Burn the Bridges, Rekindled Camp, Scorch the Map, Rubble) → cb.wpDestroyed++ (destroy/replace only).

waypointApi.name: waypointApi
waypointApi.sig: destroyWp(i) / returnWp(i) / triggerWp(i) / placeRandomWp({temp}) / cb.nslots / wpCount()
waypointApi.order: placeWp/pickSlot/nslots exist; destroy/return/trigger helpers missing. Slots modifier (Grand Survey, Celestial).

onChart.name: onChart
onChart.order: Survey Chain draw 1 (first per turn), Trail Knowledge Guard.

peekTop.name: peekTop
peekTop.when: effect code (Bearing, Waymarker, Blaze Mark, Foreknowledge)
peekTop.order: Refill-if-empty semantics must be defined (design: Bearing does not reveal).

onFlourish.name: onFlourish
onFlourish.when: playCard(): when f.flourish, BEFORE the effect
onFlourish.order: Grip Tape ×3 first time; Endless Flourish leaves 1 Momentum; Matador/Rapier riders; card-level f.flourish checks (Coup, Tempo Thrust, Crimson Flourish, Duel's End).

momentum.name: momentum
momentum.sig: cb.mom (max 5 in v2; engine caps 3) / gainMom(n) / keepMomentum flag
momentum.order: Dancing Steel: first Attack gives 2. Reset at end of turn unless press/disengage.

onParry.name: onParry
onParry.order: v2 Parry REDUCES the hit and reflects (v1 Parry = Guard + reflect). Triggers per enemy turn: 1 (Return Blow 2). Reflect ×2 (Master's Riposte). Sets cb.retort.

modifyParry.name: modifyParry
modifyParry.order: Fencing Manual +2, Salute +3 (next Parry), Riposte conditional.

retort.name: retort
retort.sig: f.retort (cb.retort set in onParry, cleared at the next player turn end)

bleed.name: bleed
bleed.when: per Attack ("one Attack" multi-hits trigger once)
bleed.order: HP loss ignores Guard; −1 after unless Hemorrhage.

intent.name: intent
intent.order: intentOf(e) exists; expose a helper incl. multi-hit total.

onPickup.name: onPickup
onPickup.order: Choices (Apothecary, Mirror of Brine, Pearl Diver's Net) open a pick screen.

onEnterRoom.name: onEnterRoom
onEnterRoom.order: Fire for "?" before resolution (Oyster Purse) and for the resolved type ("shop" for Cursed Doubloon).

canRemove.name: canRemove
canRemove.when: Scrub / Pumice / events that remove cards
canRemove.order: Saltburn (Tidemark 10) cannot be removed or transformed.

modifyCard.name: modifyCard
modifyCard.order: Only Echo Chamber uses it ("Notes deal +2"); can be folded into modifyDamage with ctx.card.id==="note".

potionApi.name: potionApi
potionApi.order: Not a card play: no Momentum, Echo or onCardPlayed. Passive potions (Second Tide) listen to onPlayerDeath.
